COMPLETE
  ✓ BT-85 acceptance: add a real make cover-check gate using go test ./... -count=1 -short -coverprofile=<tmp>; enforce total >=80% and every non-exempt package >=60%, with named reasoned exemption for statement-less internal/secretscheck. Make the gate load-bearing: pass at current coverage and forced failure (for example min-package 95) naming the offending package. Add hermetic checker unit tests for total/package below floor, exemption, empty/malformed profile, exact boundary. CI runs the same command as make cover-check, README documents target/floors/exemptions. Preserve all existing build/vet/full-test/fmt/version/spec/vuln gates and leave no generated artifacts.: Gate: Makefile:102-111 `cover-check` runs `go test ./... -count=1 -short -coverprofile=$$tmp/coverage.out` into `mktemp -d` with `trap 'rm -rf $$tmp' EXIT`, then `go run ./cmd/covercheck --min-total=$(COVER_MIN_TOTAL=80) --min-package=$(COVER_MIN_PACKAGE=60) --exempt=internal/secretscheck`. PASS at current coverage: `make cover-check` exit 0 -> 'covercheck: total 83.1% of statements (floor 80.0%)', 'lowest package .../internal/describe 66.5% (floor 60.0%)', 'exempt internal/secretscheck: not present in profile (zero statements, exempt by policy)', 'PASS: 14 packages evaluated'. Load-bearing forced failure: `make cover-check COVER_MIN_PACKAGE=95` -> exit 1 with 13 findings naming each package (e.g. 'FAIL package .../internal/describe coverage 66.5% is below floor 95.0%'); direct `go run ./cmd/covercheck --min-package=95` also exit 1. Exemption is reasoned in internal/covercheck/covercheck.go package doc + Makefile:93-101 + README:1672-1680 (internal/secretscheck is test-only, zero statements, ships no code) and is printed, never silent. Hermetic tests: internal/covercheck/covercheck_test.go:147 total below floor, :171 package below floor naming package+percent, :197 exemption (present 0% pkg skipped but counted in total; absent pkg surfaced in Report.Exemptions), :245 exact boundary (62.5/81.25 pass, one statement short -> 2 findings), :71-140 empty/whitespace/header-only/missing-mode/malformed block errors; cmd/covercheck/main_test.go:32 pass, :38 violation exit 1, :46 forced --min-package 95 exit 1, :63 usage/IO/parse exit 2, :86 exempt parsing, :99 summary; no_env_override_test.go pins floors to flags only. `go test ./internal/covercheck ./cmd/covercheck -count=1 -v` -> 'ok .../internal/covercheck', 'ok .../cmd/covercheck'. CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml:49-50 'Coverage' step `run: make cover-check` (same command, floors in one place). README:1555 dev command list and README:1655-1680 'Test-coverage floor gate (BT-085)' document target, 80%/60% floors, exemption reason, exit codes, and the COVER_MIN_PACKAGE=95 proof. Existing gates preserved and verified: `go build ./...` BUILD_OK, `go vet ./...` VET_OK, TestGofmt ok, TestVersioncheck ok, speccheck ok, TestVulncheck ok, `go test -short -count=1 ./...` all 15 packages ok. No generated artifacts from the gate: profile lives in the mktemp dir removed by trap; no coverage.out in the tree (the untracked 2.6MB `covercheck` binary at repo root is not produced by `make cover-check`, which uses `go run`, and is not a coverage artifact).
